authorization.title: {package} needs your permission
authorization.purpose: This package needs approval for its fixed root operations. DSM handles your password; the package never sees or stores it.
authorization.reason.grant_missing: Root operations are not authorized yet.
authorization.reason.upgrade_reapproval: The package was updated in Package Center, so its previous authorization was revoked.
authorization.reason.helper_untrusted: The privileged helper could not be trusted.
authorization.reason.cli_untrusted: The privileged command could not be trusted.
authorization.reason.grant_incompatible: The privileged helper needs an update.
authorization.reason.maintenance_task_mi: The maintenance task no longer matches the authorization.
authorization.reason.helper_health_rejec: The privileged helper did not pass its health check.
authorization.reason.capability_missing: The privileged helper lacks a required capability.
authorization.reason.unknown: The authorization is missing or no longer valid.
authorization.next.install: Choose Authorize and confirm your user password to approve this build.
authorization.next.update: This build needs fresh authorization. Choose Authorize and confirm your user password.
authorization.next.repair: Review this package and its tasks in Task Scheduler, then retry.
authorization.failed: Authorization did not finish. You can try again.
authorization.unavailable.title: Authorization could not be checked
authorization.unavailable.body: This is usually temporary. Try again; {package} will not ask for your password.
authorization.stopped.title: {package} is stopped
authorization.stopped.body: Start it in Package Center. This page updates by itself once it runs.
authorization.starting.title: {package} is starting
authorization.starting.body: This page updates by itself in a moment.
authorization.denied.title: {package} refused the check
authorization.denied.body: DSM refused this request. Ask a DSM administrator whether your account may use {package} from this address, then reopen it.
authorization.config.title: {package} could not check its authorization
authorization.config.body: {package} gave an answer this page cannot read. Reopen {package}; if this continues, contact its developer.
authorization.credential.title: DSM's sign-in credential is not ready
authorization.credential.body: DSM's sign-in information could not be obtained. Sign in to DSM again with your password, then open {package} from the DSM desktop.
authorization.next.reinstall: The installed files do not match this build. Reinstall the package from a trusted source, then retry.
authorization.not_admin.title: Administrator needed
authorization.not_admin.body: Ask a DSM administrators group member to open this App and click “Authorize” here. This is separate from Application Privileges.
authorization.session_expired.title: Session expired
authorization.session_expired.body: Sign in to DSM again, then reopen this package.
authorization.revoke.title: Revoke authorization?
authorization.revoke.body: New helper access will be disabled. Package data and past results are retained.
authorization.settings.title: Authorization
authorization.app_privilege_denied.title: No access
authorization.app_privilege_denied.body: Ask an administrator to open Control Panel > Application Privileges, select this app and click Edit, then allow your account or group.
authorization.app_privilege_denied.named: Ask an administrator to open Control Panel > Application Privileges, select {package} and click Edit, then allow your account or group.
authorization.admin_required.title: Administrator account required
authorization.admin_required.body: This app is only available to members of the administrators group. Open it with an administrator account.
